name: Dang Deck
summary: Rotten structural beam replaced, deck rebuilt
description: The beam under the old deck had rotted through, and it wasn't only carrying the deck. It was also holding up the corner of the house, which had already started to sag. We replaced the beam and rotten posts and stopped the corner from settling any further. Then we rebuilt the deck with a waterproof vinyl surface, aluminium railings and new stairs, with a finished ceiling underneath that turns the space below into a covered patio.
scope: Structural beam replacement, deck rebuild, stairs, railings, covered patio ceiling
